items.aka: 一类账户 · 二类账户 · 三类账户
items.aka_en: Class I · Class II · Class III

tiers.body: 额度更小、主要用于小额快捷支付的账户。账户余额与支付累计都有较低上限，适合绑定移动支付做日常小额消费。具体余额与限额以发卡行现行规则为准。
tiers.body_en: The smallest-limit account type, built mainly for small quick payments. Balance and cumulative payment caps are low, which makes it a good fit for linking to mobile payments for everyday small purchases. Exact balance and limit figures follow the issuer's current rules.

tiers.body: 功能受限的银行结算账户。可用于存款、购买理财、消费缴费和限额转出等，但转入转出、存取现金都有日累计与年累计额度约束。具体额度以发卡行现行规则为准，超限交易会被拒绝或需要通过一类账户办理。
tiers.body_en: A bank settlement account with restricted functions. It accepts deposits, wealth-management purchases, bill payments and capped transfers out, but transfers, cash deposits and withdrawals are all subject to daily and annual cumulative limits. Exact limits follow the issuer's current rules; over-limit transactions are declined or have to go through a Class I account.

tiers.body: 银行结算账户里功能最全的一类。可存取现金、转账、消费、购买理财等，日常使用基本不受额度限制。开立通常需要到银行网点或通过自助机具当面核验身份；同一家银行一般只能开一个一类账户。
tiers.body_en: The fullest-featured type of bank settlement account. It supports cash deposits and withdrawals, transfers, spending and wealth-management products, with basically no amount limits in everyday use. Opening one usually requires verifying your identity in person at a branch or self-service kiosk, and a bank normally allows only one Class I account per customer.

items.body: 线上支付时由发卡行额外做的一步持卡人身份验证，常见形式是跳转银行页面输入密码或短信验证码。Visa 叫 Visa Secure，万事达叫 Mastercard Identity Check 等。支持 3DS 的卡在境外网站付款时更容易通过，不支持时可能被网站直接拒付。
items.body_en: An extra cardholder identity check the issuer runs during online checkout, usually a redirect to the bank's page to enter a password or SMS code. Visa calls it Visa Secure; Mastercard calls it Mastercard Identity Check. Cards with 3DS support get through overseas checkouts more easily — without it, the site may decline the payment outright.

items.body: 印在卡片背面签名栏附近的 3 位数字（美国运通在卡面为 4 位），线上支付时用来证明付款人持有实体卡。它和密码不同，不要告诉他人，也不要截图外发；银行客服不会索要 CVV。
items.body_en: The 3 digits printed next to the signature strip on the back of the card (4 digits on the front for American Express). Online payments use it to prove you physically hold the card. It is not your PIN: never tell anyone or send screenshots of it — bank support will never ask for your CVV.

items.body: 卡号最前面的一段数字，通常取前 6 到 8 位，用来识别发卡银行、卡组织和卡种（如借记或信用）。查 BIN 可以大致判断一张卡的归属，但不能凭 BIN 推断完整卡号或账户信息。
items.body_en: The leading digits of a card number, normally the first 6 to 8, which identify the issuing bank, the card network and the product type (debit or credit). A BIN lookup can roughly tell you where a card belongs, but it cannot be used to derive the full card number or account details.

items.body: 当交易币种与卡片结算币种不一致时，卡组织或发卡行按比例收取的费用。卡面或参数里写「无货币转换费」表示这笔费用被减免，但汇率本身仍按卡组织或银行公布的汇率折算，实际入账金额以账单为准。
items.body_en: A percentage fee the card network or issuer charges when the transaction currency differs from the card's settlement currency. If a card says "no conversion fee", this charge is waived — but the exchange rate itself still follows the rate published by the network or bank, and the amount billed is whatever lands on the statement.

items.body: 外币交易后，银行自动按当日汇率把外币金额折算成人民币记入人民币账户还款的功能。开通后一般不需要手动购汇；没有自动购汇的卡，可能需要持卡人主动购汇或存入外币还款。
items.body_en: After a foreign-currency purchase, the bank automatically converts the amount into RMB at that day's rate and bills it to your RMB account. With Auto FX on, you normally never need to buy foreign currency by hand; without it, you may have to purchase FX or deposit foreign currency yourself to settle the bill.

items.body: 酒店、租车等商户在正式结算前，先向发卡行冻结一笔额度作押金的做法。冻结期间这笔额度不可用，完成结算后按实际消费扣款并释放剩余冻结；如果长时间未完成，冻结会自动到期释放，时间以发卡行规则为准。
items.body_en: Hotels, car rentals and similar merchants ask the issuer to freeze an amount as a deposit before final settlement. The frozen amount is unavailable while held; once settled, the actual charge is taken and the rest is released. If settlement never happens, the hold expires on its own after a period set by the issuer's rules.

items.body: 用银行卡在境外 ATM 取当地现金。可能同时产生发卡行手续费、境外 ATM 运营方费用以及货币转换费用，下单前 ATM 屏幕通常会提示；选择以当地货币结算一般更划算。发卡行侧费用减免情况以该行现行规则为准。
items.body_en: Withdrawing local cash from an ATM abroad with your bank card. Issuer fees, a surcharge from the local ATM operator and a currency conversion fee can stack together; the ATM screen normally warns you before you confirm. Choosing to settle in the local currency is usually the better deal. Fee waivers on the issuer's side follow that bank's current rules.

items.aka: 线上支付 / 无卡支付
items.body: 不插卡、只凭卡号、有效期和 CVV 等信息在网站或 App 里付款的方式。能否网付取决于发卡行是否开放、卡组织通道是否支持以及商户是否接入，境外购物还会叠加 3DS 验证的结果。
items.body_en: Paying on a website or in an app with only the card number, expiry date and CVV — no physical card involved. Whether it works depends on the issuer enabling it, the network supporting it and the merchant being connected; overseas purchases also depend on the 3DS check.

items.body: 部分境外或特殊场景下，发卡行按交易金额的一定比例额外冻结一笔资金作担保，交易完成或到期后释放。比例不是手续费，不会被扣收；只是暂时占用额度或余额，具体比例见卡片参数与发卡行说明。
items.body_en: In some overseas or special situations, the issuer freezes an extra percentage of the transaction amount as security, released when the transaction completes or expires. The ratio is not a fee and is never deducted — it only ties up credit limit or balance for a while. Exact ratios are given in the card's specs and the issuer's notes.
